primary.title: Top 5 small-cap funds can take 28 days longer than mid-caps to sell half of their portfolios: Experts discuss risks
primary.summary: SEBI’s FY26 data shows top five small-cap funds take 51 days to liquidate half their portfolios, versus 23 days for mid-caps. Experts say lower small-cap liquidity and rising AUM can increase redemption risks, making stress-test trends worth monitoring.
